component.name: Tether
component.summary: Your Android phone on your desktop

description.p: Tether puts your Android phone on your Linux desktop. Text from your computer, see and answer phone notifications, and open your phone's apps in their own windows. It works on any desktop, including GNOME, KDE Plasma, Sway and i3.
On the phone you use the free KDE Connect app. Tether is the computer side.

ul.li: Messages: your conversations with names from your contacts, picture messages, and a copy button for one-time codes
Phone apps in their own windows, set up by scanning one QR code
Notifications from the phone, with replies and actions
Clipboard shared both ways, files and links sent by dropping them on the window
What plays on the phone, on your keyboard's media keys
Ring your phone to find it

description.p: Phone apps in their own windows, set up by scanning a QR code. Pin phone apps to the computer's app menu. Safer pairing and file transfers.
First release: messages, notifications, clipboard, files and media controls.
